name: VieMed Healthcare
old_description: Founded in 2006 by Casey Hoyt and Michael Moore, VieMed was built on friendship, loyalty, and treating others right. These ideals remain at the core of our culture as we continue to grow, expand into new markets, and advance care for patients throughout the United States.
about:
VieMed Healthcare is headquartered in Lafayette, Louisiana, and was founded in 2006 by Casey Hoyt and Michael Moore. The company began on a foundation of friendship, loyalty, and a commitment to treating others right, ideals that continue to shape its culture as it expands across the United States.

The company delivers a range of in-home clinical services centered on respiratory care and disease management. Its licensed respiratory therapists provide 24/7 personalized care for conditions such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, neuromuscular diseases, and obstructive sleep apnea, using remote monitoring technologies and proprietary connected health platforms. VieMed also operates VieMed Healthcare Staffing (VHS), a Joint Commission–certified division that places clinical professionals in facilities and homes nationwide. Through its PACE program, the organization focuses on reducing exacerbations, readmissions, and emergency visits via one-on-one patient assessments. As a publicly traded entity listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and NASDAQ (VMD), VieMed operates a national family of brands serving thousands of patients.

VieMed serves patients directly — from infancy through end of life — as well as healthcare organizations, providers, and payers seeking staffing solutions or disease management partnerships. Its clinical teams include respiratory therapists, licensed clinical social workers, and healthcare administrators who coordinate care across the continuum.

The company distinguishes itself through a high-tech, high-touch model that combines proprietary remote monitoring with in-person clinician visits. Its comprehensive disease management approach aims to lower hospitalization rates, improve patient satisfaction, and reduce overall costs, while its staffing division holds Joint Commission accreditation as a mark of quality.

about:
VirTechnology Contract Manufacturing operates from Windsor, Vermont, as a start-up contract manufacturer focused on printed circuit board assembly and box-build services. The company was founded to provide turnkey manufacturing solutions for clients across medical, military, aerospace, and weapons sectors, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop delivers turnkey PCB assembly encompassing surface-mount placement, multi-zone solder reflow, through-hole soldering, component procurement, fixture creation, kitting, functional testing, visual inspection, and depanelization via mouse-bite tabs, v-score, or CNC routing. It handles part sizes from 0402 up to 40 mm × 40 mm and targets low-to-medium volume runs, with conformal coating, injection molding, and CNC machining listed as upcoming capabilities.

Customers include original equipment manufacturers and design firms in the medical device, defense, aerospace, and weapons industries that require domestic production to protect intellectual property and supply chains. The company emphasizes its ability to integrate customer-supplied test equipment and procedures into the validation process.

VirTechnology cites its onsite IPC-A-610 certified trainer, a commitment to keeping IP and supply chains within the United States, and a streamlined quoting-to-production workflow as key differentiators.

name: Virginia Food Works
old_description: The cannery is open to commercial clients by appointment only. Scheduling is prioritized on a first come, first served basis and reservations should be made up to a month in advance during the busy season (June-December). For “home canning” availability, visit the
about:
Virginia Food Works operates a VDACS-inspected commercial kitchen at the Prince Edward County Cannery in Farmville, Virginia. The nonprofit organization was established to support Virginia farmers by offering a rental production facility for small-batch commercial retail co-packing during harvest season.

The facility provides access to licensed equipment including kettles, mixers, fillers, and canners for hot-fill, water-bath, and pressure canning processes. Commercial clients schedule appointments Thursday through Saturday, with reservations recommended up to a month ahead during the peak season from June through December. The shared-use model allows growers to process seasonal harvests such as tomatoes, berries, apples, peppers, and ginger root into shelf-stable acid and acidified products.

Services are directed at Virginia and out-of-state farmers as well as emerging small-business food entrepreneurs. The cannery produces sauces, jams, relishes, syrups, and similar value-added items, but cannot handle meat, fish, or dairy due to licensing scope. Clients receive guidance on recipe scaling, regulatory compliance including Process Authority Review and VDACS registration, and food safety training such as ServSafe and Better Process Control School.

The organization’s stated mission is to strengthen Virginia’s food system by reducing waste, preserving crops, and expanding market opportunities for local producers through value-added production. A resource-first approach aims to equip clients with knowledge of cost structures, scheduling, and regulatory requirements before they commit to commercial runs.

name: Virginia Packing
old_description: Virginia Packing is a specialty co-packer for cured meats, cheeses and other quality foods. We specialize in products that require careful handling and extra attention to detail.
about:
Virginia Packing operates from Toano, Virginia, where it was founded in 2011. The company is a specialty co-packer focused on cured meats, cheeses, and other quality foods that require careful handling and extra attention to detail.

The facility is USDA and FDA inspected and SQF certified. It houses a Weber high-speed slicer and a GEA thermoforming packaging machine, enabling high-speed precision slicing, deboning, modified atmosphere packaging (MAP), vacuum and shrink packaging, and hand-cutting of specialty cheeses. The company also provides air-conditioned, refrigerated, and frozen storage along with cross-docking logistics, leveraging proximity to the Hampton Roads ports and Interstate 95.

Virginia Packing serves the food processing industry, particularly producers of cured meats, cheeses, sausages, and specialty items. A noted client is La Tienda, the online retailer for Spanish imports, for whom Virginia Packing acts as the exclusive slicer and packer of Spanish jamón.

The company positions itself as large enough to feature top-quality equipment and facilities, yet small enough to take special care of each product, emphasizing careful handling and exact specifications for every job.

name: Virginia Vinegar Works
old_description: This rare vinegar is dark red and heavy bodied with a rich nose. It goes well with bold, mixed greens and blue cheese. Particularly good in a meat marinade or to add structure in marinara sauces and stews
about:
Virginia Vinegar Works was founded in 2008 in Shipman, Virginia. The company began with humble production of wine vinegar in porcelain crocks and has since expanded to using stainless steel tanks for fermentation and older wine barrels for ageing.

The company produces artisanal vinegars using the traditional Orleans method, a slow conversion process that retains the character of the base wine. Its lineup includes barrel-aged wine vinegars (both blended and single-varietal), seasonal fruit vinegars made with fresh local fruit, and robust malt vinegars sourced from nearby craft breweries. Production occurs in stainless steel tanks with extended barrel ageing, though facility size and output volumes are not disclosed.

Virginia Vinegar Works serves professional chefs, restaurants, gourmet food outlets, and home cooks seeking exceptional flavor. Its products are marketed for both culinary professionals and retail consumers, with an emphasis on local ingredients from Virginia vineyards and farms.

The business was born from a desire to add exceptional flavor to the region's produce and meats. The founders chose the Orleans method specifically to preserve the original wine's richness and character, and they continue to select barrels for blending after extended ageing.

about:
Volt Industrial Plastics Inc operates from Yellville, Arkansas. Founded by Joe Voltrauer, the company traces its roots from Germany to Arkansas and has been providing custom plastic fastener solutions for over three decades. The Voltrauer family story continues to mold the parts produced today.

The company manufactures a wide range of plastic fasteners under one roof, including bushings, washers, threaded rod, stem bumpers, standoffs, rivets, push-in fasteners, pins, spacers, screws, studs, nuts, metric hardware, clips, circuit board hardware, caps, plugs, and cable routing components. The product line also features cable clamps, wire clamps, dowel pins, hex nuts, plastic rivets, security screws, plastic washers, cup washers, hole plugs, and square head screws. All items are crafted in the Yellville facility, allowing the company to control quality and lead times.

Volt serves national and global markets, with its circuit board hardware category indicating a presence in the electronics sector. The company emphasizes American-made production and worldwide shipping without hidden fees, targeting customers who value domestic sourcing and transparent pricing.

The Volt difference is built on passion-driven engineering, customer care, and domestic manufacturing. Founder Joe Voltrauer’s story of rising above challenges shapes the company’s focus on quality parts and knowledgeable customer service, with representatives available directly by phone.

name: VoltServer®
old_description: Another step in empowering more industries with intelligent power distribution East Greenwich, April 12, 2024 – VoltServer, a leading provider of Digital Electricity™ (DE), Fault Managed Power solutions, has attained Cisco Select Developer status. This accomplishment demonstrates VoltServer’s expertise and solidifies its position as a trusted and valued collaborator within the industry. The collaboration between VoltServer and Cisco opens new opportunities for both companies to drive innovation in efficient and sustainable power delivery solutions. With VoltServer’s proven expertise in Digital Electricity™ combined with Cisco’s leadership in the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) technologies, the companies are driving advancements in powering industrial and outdoor environments where traditional power sources are limited or inaccessible. VoltServer’s Digital Edge Solutions, combined with Cisco’s IIOT platforms, enable enterprise-grade connectivity in even the most rugged and challenging spaces. Together, they empower organizations to deploy Cisco IE Series Power over Ethernet (PoE) switches deeper into their networks, delivering enhanced efficiency, connectivity, and performance. “We are very excited to become a trusted powering solution for Cisco’s IIoT solutions,” states Matt Giuliano, EVP and GM, Emeritus, Communications and In-Building at VoltServer, “and to continue to work with Cisco’s engineering teams to collectively address joint go-to-market opportunities in several strategic vertical markets including extended campus & outdoor spaces, ports and airports, utilities and oil & gas.” The attainment of Cisco Select Developer status marks a significant milestone for VoltServer as they continue their 10-year deployment history as the industry’s pioneering leader in Fault Managed Power, via their Digital Electricity platform. “We are driven by innovation and are proud to be setting the standard in Fault Managed Power Systems. Together, with our valued partners, we are solving the world’s power distribution demands and building solutions to create a better future for us all,” says Stephen Eaves, CEO and Founder at VoltServer.
about:
VoltServer is headquartered in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. Founded by Stephen Eaves, who serves as CEO, the company has spent over a decade deploying its Digital Electricity™ fault-managed power systems across critical infrastructure.

The company designs and manufactures Digital Electricity™ transmitters and receivers that use patented packet energy transfer to deliver high-power electricity over hybrid fiber cable or existing data pathways. Its platform includes real-time telemetry, remote firmware updates, and policy-based control, supported by a team of solution engineers who assist with system design at no charge. VoltServer reports more than 1,000 building installations and 40,000 circuits in large venues.

VoltServer serves service providers building 5G and Wi-Fi networks, transportation hubs such as airports and ports, enterprise campuses, industrial manufacturing facilities automating production, data centers adding AI server racks, and building electrification projects for smart real estate. The company also lists telecom, data center, enterprise, and transportation as core markets.

VoltServer differentiates itself through inherent safety — its Class 4 fault-managed power stops hazardous current within milliseconds — rapid deployment that often avoids conduit and permitting, and NEC recognition in the 2023 code. The technology reduces material use, qualifies for LEED credits, and earned Cisco Select Developer status for integration with industrial IoT switches.
